2317-5478-7084-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
2317-5478-7084-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Loot by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat.

280-2645-3430-4348.easyPrerequisites: Ley Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
280-2645-3430-4348.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Golgari Rot Farm
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ley Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2034-4885-6723-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

1116-1580-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-969-1526.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
215-969-1526.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Circle of Dreams Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Circle of Dreams Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5670-6097-6705.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
5670-6097-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2510-5638-7070.notablePrerequisites:
There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
You control at least four Equipment.
2510-5638-7070.description:
Activate Plate Armor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Plate Armor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Semblance Anvil.
Repeat.

3532-4997-5060-5078.notablePrerequisites:
There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
You control another Knight and/or Merfolk.
3532-4997-5060-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Knight and/or Merfolk you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1978-4832-6893.description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat.
1978-4832-6893.notes: If The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it, you can instead use its second ability to get infinite colored mana. You can also use both interchangeably, if desired.

2034-5224-5645-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, it and Together Forever trigger.
Resolve the Marketback Walker trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Together Forever trigger, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

586-5060-5258-5618-6797.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
586-5060-5258-5618-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Kami of Whispered Hopes

81-725-2034-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 3 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
81-725-2034-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Sin, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.

700-3090-3862.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has two or more cards in hand.
700-3090-3862.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal nonlethal damage to Body of Knowledge after it is donated to an opponent.
700-3090-3862.description:
Donate Body of Knowledge to an opponent that has two or more cards in hand, then deal nonlethal damage to it.
Body of Knowledge triggers, causing its controller to draw that many cards.
Orcish Bowmaster triggers for each card drawn. Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to Body of Knowledge and causing you to amass Orcs 1.
Repeat from step 2.

104-2086-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 3 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Repeat.

1796-3967-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
1796-3967-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
1796-3967-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1247-5536-6410.easyPrerequisites: Rex, Cyber-Hound does not have summoning sickness.
1247-5536-6410.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed. You control at least 2 Goblins.
Howlsquad Heavy and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-5536-6410.description:
Activate Rex using Howlsquad Heavy's ability by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2232-4050-6251.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax if applicable
2232-4050-6251.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six artifact and/or creature cards in your graveyard.
2232-4050-6251.description:
Cast Aatchik either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Aatchik enters the battlefield, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Aatchik trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token for each artifact and/or creature card in your graveyard.
When the Insects enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers that many times. 
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six Insects, adding {3}{B}{B}{G}.
When the Insects die, Aatchik's second ability triggers six times, putting six +1/+1 counters on Aatchik and causing each opponent to lose 6 life.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Aatchik from the battlefield to your hand with the first trigger and returning nothing to your hand with each subsequent trigger.
Repeat.
2232-4050-6251.notes: If you have seven or more artifact and/or creature cards in your graveyard, this combo will net infinite tokens, mana and +1/+1 counters on Aatchik.

997-2523-5561.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Relentless Rohirrim.
When Relentless Rohirrim dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Relentless Rohirrim that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Relentless Rohirrim token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Relentless Rohirrim token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1987-2104-3277-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2104-3277-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

719-1238-2351-2438-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

330-2557-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander, and your commander is a Pirate.
You control at least one additional creature or artifact.
330-2557-4508.description:
Activate your commander by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2034-4053-5944.notablePrerequisites: Unstoppable Slasher does not have a counter on it.
2034-4053-5944.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher, adding {C}{C}.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with zero stun counters due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

513-1741-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}.
513-1741-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Cloud of Faeries to your hand from the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying {1}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Palinchron to your hand from the battlefield.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.
If you control a land that can tap to produce at least {2}, this combo nets infinite mana.

527-1432-1753.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{W}{G}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Samut and Selvala.
Repeat.

1455-1810-2523-4365.description:
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying {1}{U}{U}, targeting Mondrak.
Vesuvan Duplimancy triggers, creating two nonlegendary token copies of Mondrak.
Resolve Cackling Counterpart, creating eight copies of Mondrak.
Put all but one legendary Mondrak into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Mondraks die, Ratadrabik triggers eight times.
Resolve the first Ratadrabik trigger, creating a number of nonlegendary token copies of Mondrak equal to 2^(the number of Mondraks you currently control) that are 2/2 Zombies in addition to their other types.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.

751-907-3314-3470.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Lotus Cobra.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {U}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

282-404-1322-2105.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents are unable to block and kill any of your creatures.
282-404-1322-2105.description:
Move to your combat step.
Attack with Delina, Ghired, and all Combat Celebrants you control, exerting any Combat Celebrants that can be exerted.
Delina, Ghired, and any Combat Celebrants you exerted trigger.
Resolve the Delina trigger, creating at least one token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Ghired trigger, making a token copy of a Combat Celebrant token you control that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve any Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and giving you an additional combat phase.
At end of combat, Delina triggers, exiling any token copy of Combat Celebrant that it created.
Repeat.
